claims: Dengue fever is also called "breakbone fever".
Dengue fever is a viral mosquito-borne disease.
Dengue fever causes high fever.
Dengue fever causes severe headache.
Dengue fever causes eye pain.
Dengue fever causes joint pain.
Dengue fever causes muscle pain.
Dengue fever typically lasts 4–7 days.
Most people with dengue fever recover in two weeks.
Dengue fever is spread by Aedes mosquitoes.
Dengue fever is caused by any of four closely related dengue viruses (DENV).
Dengue fever is transmitted through the bite of infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes.
Dengue fever is transmitted through the bite of infected Aedes albopictus mosquitoes.
Dengue fever does not spread directly from person to person.
Mosquitoes can become infected with the dengue virus from biting a person who has the virus.
Symptoms of dengue fever appear 3-14 days after a bite.
Symptoms of dengue fever often start with high fever.
Symptoms of dengue fever often start with severe headache.
Symptoms of dengue fever often start with pain behind the eyes.
Symptoms of dengue fever often start with severe muscle pains.
Symptoms of dengue fever often start with severe joint pains.
The "breakbone" effect refers to severe muscle/joint pains.
Other symptoms of dengue fever include rash.
Other symptoms of dengue fever include nausea.
Other symptoms of dengue fever include vomiting.
Most cases of dengue fever are mild.
Most cases of dengue fever resolve on their own within 1–2 weeks.
Traveling to or living in tropical/subtropical climates (e.g., Southeast Asia, Americas, Africa) is the primary risk factor for dengue fever.
Dengue fever risk is particularly high during the rainy season.
Previous infection with a different serotype of the dengue virus increases the risk of severe dengue.
Severe dengue is also called dengue hemorrhagic fever.
Severe dengue is a medical emergency.
Severe dengue is characterized by severe abdominal pain.
Severe dengue is characterized by persistent vomiting.
Severe dengue is characterized by bleeding gums.
Severe dengue is characterized by bleeding nose.
Severe dengue is characterized by rapid breathing.
Severe dengue is characterized by blood in stool.
Severe dengue is characterized by blood in vomit.
There is no specific antiviral medication for dengue.
Rest, hydration, and acetaminophen for pain.
Severe cases of dengue fever can cause bleeding.
Severe cases of dengue fever can cause death.
